blurb: Ashtanga Yoga Austin offers traditional Mysore-style Ashtanga Yoga classes where students learn postures one at a time directly from the teacher, progressing at their own pace. Classes include mostly silent Mysore practice and weekly led classes guiding the Primary Series. The practice emphasizes breath synchronization, internal heat generation, and meditative focus.
